capabilities: Open folder index notes as pages
Reorder files manually by drag and drop
Assign colorful icons to files and folders
Hide files or folders by name or path rules
Switch reading, editing, or source view per note
disambiguation: Not a task manager plugin alone; it is primarily a file explorer replacement that also includes an inline task system.
extras: Formerly Branch & Order; merges Branch Note and Explorer Order Editor. Command prefix changed from branch-order: to beautify:, so existing hotkeys must be rebound. Data migrates automatically on first enable.
intentEvidence: Formerly known as Branch & Order; existing data migrates automatically.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer lacks folder index pages, manual ordering, icons, and per-note view control, and inline task metadata is not organized into task views.

summary: File explorer enhancement that makes folders act as pages with manual ordering, colorful icons, hide rules, per-note view modes, and an inline task system with dashboard, Kanban, and quadrant views.
